name: Square wave 8-bar
desc: Grime square-wave bass in Eb minor: the raw PlayStation-soundcard square riding an 8-bar phrase — four bars of riff, four bars of low answer with octave jumps — filter sweeping like Rhythm & Gash era instrumentals. Menacing, monophonic, all forward motion.

code.full: note("<[eb1 ~ ~ eb1 ~ ~ gb1 ~] [eb1 ~ ~ eb1 ~ ~ eb2 ~] [eb1 ~ ~ eb1 ~ ~ gb1 ~] [eb1 ~ eb1 ~ gb1 ~ ab1 ~] [bb1 ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~ ab1 ~] [bb1 ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~ bb2 ~] [ab1 ~ ~ ab1 ~ ~ gb1 ~] [eb1 ~ eb1 ~ db1 ~ eb1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("square").attack(.006).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.12).shape(.4).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).gain(${gain}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[eb1 eb2 ~ eb1 ~ eb2 gb1 ~] [eb1 eb2 ~ eb1 ~ ~ eb2 eb1] [eb1 eb2 ~ eb1 ~ eb2 gb1 ~] [eb1 ~ eb1 gb1 ~ ab1 ~ ab2] [bb1 bb2 ~ bb1 ~ ~ ab1 ab2] [bb1 bb2 ~ bb1 ~ bb2 bb1 ~] [ab1 ab2 ~ ab1 ~ ~ gb1 gb2] [eb1 eb2 eb1 ~ db1 db2 eb1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("square").attack(.005).decay(.25).sustain(.28).release(.1).shape(.45).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.8).slow(8)).lpq(4).gain(${gain}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
